entities.summary: Napoleon, a notable figure in the history of Italy, associated with Risorgimento and Italian Unification (1796–1848). Preceded by Napoleonic Italy and Restoration. Their legacy influenced Kingdom of Italy proclaimed with Victor Emmanuel II as king and Italian forces capture Rome; completion of unification.
